'''The Forever Pack''' is an offer in the [[Exclusive Shop (Pet Simulator 99)|Exclusive Shop]] that was introduced with [[Update Log (Pet Simulator 99)|Update 7]].
Each pack always contains an unlimited number of items or pets that can be purchased in sequence. 
Paid items in turn alternate with free items. These offers are generated randomly so that the offers differ for the players. Robux amounts are ascending and start at {{Robux}} 50 and currently end at {{Robux}} 2,400. The more the player has purchased, the higher the next Robux amount to be paid as well as the possible equivalent value that can ultimately result in a [[Gargantuan Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|gargantuan pet]]. 

With further updates, packs will refresh to match the update's theme. Currently only theme-specific packs are available. [[Potions (Pet Simulator 99)|Potions]], [[Keys (Pet Simulator 99)|keys]], Exclusive Raffle Tickets, and the current [[Exclusive Pets Egg (Pet Simulator 99)|Exclusive Eggs]], for example, are an integral part of the pack. Some [[Hoverboard (Pet Simulator 99)|hoverboards]], [[Gargantuan Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|gargantuan pets]], [[Titanic Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|titanic pets]], and [[Huge Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|huge pets]] can only be purchased within the pack. 

As of Update 59, the [[Exclusive Raffle (Pet Simulator 99)|Exclusive Raffle]] can be accessed through the top right of any ongoing Forever Pack.
==Contents==
Note: Since the Backrooms Forever Pack, limited items such as [[Huge Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|huge pets]], [[Booths (Pet Simulator 99)|booths]], and [[Hoverboard (Pet Simulator 99)|hoverboards]] may be included. They have a chance of appearing from the {{Robux}} 100 tier onwards, and titanic pets have a chance of appearing from the {{Robux}} 400 tier onwards. The table below shows the items that are included permanently in every pack. 
{{ForeverPackContents}}
Exclusive Raffle Tickets appear in every tier after {{Robux}} 250, with the {{Robux}} 2,400 tier giving up to 30 tickets.

Mega Lucky Tiles appear in four luck tiers, with the lowest appearing at {{Robux}} 400. Items included in Mega Lucky Tiles include Mini Chests, Rainbow Mini Chests, Mega Chests, the current Exclusive Egg, an Active Huge Egg, and the current limited pets within the pack. This is the only way to obtain a gargantuan pet from the Forever Pack.

== Trivia ==
* To ensure compliance with regulations concerning paid random items, the Forever Pack cannot be accessed if the player is located in Australia, Belgium, Netherlands, South Korea, or the UK (if the user is under 18).
* By today, The Forever Pack won't retrieve its former name, but instead will phase through names that will relate to the updates the game obtains.
* During the St. Patrick's Event, the [[Huge Lucki Dominus (Pet Simulator 99)|Huge Lucki Dominus]] which was already in the game - was briefly included in the Forever Pack, but was replaced by [[Huge Lucki Wolf (Pet Simulator 99)|Huge Lucki Wolf]] shortly thereafter.
